title: OSR Rule File
description: A JSON file containing symbolic mathematical rules. Conforms to EARS Specification OSR v0.1, §5.

section.description: Taxonomy section number (e.g. '1.1.1', '4.3', '8.6'). Together with each rule id, this forms the required canonical rule identity `section:id`. Per OSR-F-003, OSR-F-008, OSR-T-003.

title.description: Human-readable title of this rule section. Per OSR-F-003.

semantics.description: Mapping of every mathematical operator used in the file to its official OpenMath Content Dictionary symbol.

additionalProperties.description: The OpenMath CD symbol identifier, for example 'openmath:arith1#root'.

rules.description: Ordered array of symbolic rules. Position within array defines priority (first match wins). Per OSR-F-005, OSR-F-009.

rule.description: A single symbolic rule: pattern + constraints → result. Per OSR-F-006, OSR-F-007.

id.description: Required positive integer component of the canonical rule identity `section:id`; ids must be unique within their containing rule file. NOT a priority key — priority is determined by load order + position in array. Per OSR-F-008, OSR-F-009.

pattern.description: OSR-Expr with wildcards describing the expression form to match. Per OSR-F-006.

constraints.description: Array of predicate expressions that must all be true (implicit AND) for the rule to apply. Empty array means unconditional. Per OSR-F-006, OSR-C-031.

result.description: OSR-Expr of the rewritten expression. May contain functions, utility functions. Per OSR-F-006.

description.description: Human-readable description of the rule, e.g. '∫(a+b·x)^n dx, n∈ℤ⁺'. Per OSR-F-007.

section.description: Override section number if different from file-level section. Per OSR-F-007.

references.description: Bibliographic references (G&R, CRC, A&S rule numbers). Per OSR-F-007, OSR-D-003.

GR.description: Gradshteyn & Ryzhik 'Table of Integrals' rule number

CRC.description: CRC Standard Mathematical Tables rule number

AS.description: Abramowitz & Stegun 'Handbook of Mathematical Functions' rule number

derivation.description: Mathematical technique or basis identity used to derive the rule. Per OSR-F-007.
